answer.markdown: **Pick JSONB.** It avoids migration overhead and handles sparse, evolving schemas natively; Postgres GIN or expression indexes give you query performance on specific keys. Switch to a normalized table only when you need complex relational queries (joins across preferences), strict constraints (foreign keys, rigid typing), or when high volume and large JSONB rows cause measurable performance degradation.
